columns: commitment: x0 estimate at that run's own commitment step
final: x0 estimate at the last step
seed_choice: nearest individual commitment step to the pair's registered median, ties broken by lower seed number
caveat: all three columns are Tweedie estimates decoded through the VAE for display; the 0.90 cosine threshold that defines commitment was computed in latent space, not on these decoded pixels, and the perceptual check against it is still owed (docs/evidence/EXP01-commitment-step/QUERY.md)
